assumptions.building: the fictitious three-zone twin (three-zone-hvac-seasonal-v2); every limit comes from the site policy, never from an algorithm
assumptions.governed_today: All 10 supervisory write tools (set_zone_setpoint, set_zone_cooling_setpoint, set_zone_co2_setpoint, set_zone_lighting_setpoint, set_zone_lighting_mode, set_supply_air_setpoint, set_tank_setpoint, set_heat_pump_limit, set_ahu_enabled, set_heating_cable_mode) are governed write tools with signed ToolSpecs (schema v5 with signed postconditions), REMORA cumulative limits, protected dispatcher, local twin interlocks (IL-01..IL-11), and independent effect observer. Offline runs apply proposals directly for speed; Caretaker(..., dispatcher=...) drives the exact same proposal engine through governed tool calls.
assumptions.expected_effects: No profile carries a planning prior. The measured effect of each strategy is in docs/results and applies to the twin only.

selection.model: safety overlays (any number) + exactly one base profile + one algorithm per setpoint
order: one base profile, highest priority that matches
algorithm per setpoint from the profile's allowlist
decision record; a write goes to REMORA as VERIFY with the record as evidence

overlays.trigger: any zone below frost_overlay_zone_c (an independent frost thermostat), or the 24 h outdoor mean below frost_overlay_outdoor_mean_c
overlays.effect: heating never below frost_overlay_heating_min_c; no heat-pump cap
cables cannot be off or on the air thermostat

overlays.trigger: a zone reading stale (older than max_observation_age_s), a jump above max_reading_jump_k_per_step, or a wrong unit
overlays.effect: that zone runs on the fallback schedule (no sensor) until the recovery criterion holds; escalated once

overlays.trigger: a DHW hygiene cycle or alarm
overlays.note: the twin has no domestic hot water

profiles.trigger: a top-3 price hour of the day on a day with >= 0.40 NOK/kWh spread, or building power above 0.9 x the month's peak
profiles.note: internal price and peak signals only; an external DR event (OpenADR) is not implemented

profiles.trigger: an optimal-start recovery is running, or a price block within 2 h and occupancy within 6 h (heating season)
the fallback: a proposal failed validation
a valid thermal model and price and weather forecasts
profiles.note: economic MPC; would run behind the same validator and fallback
shadow only, never a physical write
a coordinator would assign budgets; each building's REMORA still authorizes

algorithms.rule: 21 degC while occupied (IL-02 floor 20)
the laboratory holds 21 degC
19 degC unoccupied
the latest start that reaches 21 degC at occupancy: deficit over a self-tuning reheat rate + 1 h, at most 12 h, latched
>= 10 h to occupancy: 16 degC at a 24 h mean >= 0, 17 at >= -5, else 18
a further -1 K in an unoccupied top-price hour, never below the setback floor
+0.5 K (max 21.5) when occupancy is within 3 h and a price block within 2 h
occupied heating -min(0.5, 0.5 z_p) K, z_p the price's relative excess over the day's median; floor 20.5
algorithms.note: measured on NO1 2025: -9 kWh, -31 NOK spot, +268 NOK power charge (rebound peak); off by default

algorithms.rule: 23.5 degC while occupied and 1 h before
28 degC when empty
19 degC in the heating season
requests = zones within 0.5 K of cooling; respond -0.5 K per request, at most 1 K; trim +0.5 K; 15..21 degC
outside the heating season, unoccupied, 20..04 UTC, zones > 22.5 and outdoor 10 degC and >= 3 K colder: AHU on at 15 degC through the HRV bypass; stop below 21
on while occupied and 1 h before (IL-06), or for a purge or the IAQ overlay
radiator curve + 5 K, 45..55 degC, <= 3 K per step
+5 K in the day's cheapest 4 hours when the spread >= 0.40 NOK/kWh, heating season
60 % while building power > 0.9 x the month's peak, or in an unoccupied top-price hour, and the tank holds (IL-09); never during a recovery or frost
lit while present, dimmed by daylight
on while the ground sensor reports a wet surface at the icing band
